essence: One who recites after rising at dawn obtains the merit of all holy places.
For the fearful one, there is no fear from ghosts, spirits, and demons.
The reciter obtains worship everywhere on earth like a son of the goddess.
May the speaker's mind-swan rejoice long in the attained endless ocean of essence.
There is no fear from enemies for the devotees of the elephant-enemy.
